## About
Vital Pest Defense is a small, family owned pest company on Camino Real in Kyle. We work on homes, from regular treatments to tracking down critters that have found their way into the attic.
Reviewers mention Raymond by name, and they talk about how he answers questions in detail and does a thorough job looking into the problem before treating it.
We're rated 5 from 40 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to help with whatever is bugging you at home.

## Services
- Quarterly treatments: Pest treatments on a quarterly schedule.
- Attic critter inspections: If you suspect critters nesting in your attic, we do a thorough inspection to track down what's going on.

## FAQ
Q: Will you explain what you're using in my home?
A: Yes. A reviewer said Raymond took his time explaining which chemicals he would recommend for their home.

Q: What if the problem isn't solved?
A: A reviewer noted that we will come back if there are any problems after a treatment.

Q: Can you come out on a Sunday?
A: A reviewer was glad Raymond was available on a Sunday. Give us a call and we'll work out a time.
